run_evaluation: run the NLI model evaluation on a checkpoint with specified eval data and model class
run_evaluation_cpu: run the NLI evaluation using only CPU instead of GPU for the model checkpoint
run_evaluation_save_predictions: run the NLI evaluation and save predictions to a specified output path as JSONL
run_evaluation_batch_size: run the NLI evaluation with a custom per GPU batch size for faster processing
run_evaluation_max_length: run the NLI evaluation with a custom max sequence length for tokenized inputs
